checks.detail: Native ranking and trace download fit a 390-pixel phone viewport without a full app or provider request.

checks.name: posting_progress

checks.name: posting_failure_retains_search

method.reopen: same_page_after_fragment_close_and_content_removal; JavaScript modules can remain in memory
method.clock: page performance.now for DOM; Python monotonic for driver/protocol intervals

limits: Offline preview only: no source downloads, embeddings or AI generation.
DOM timings observe layout availability, including offscreen controls, not physical paint or field INP.
Driver timings include automation/protocol overhead; clocks are never subtracted across processes.
Fresh contexts share processes; this is not a cold/warm-cache or hosted/mobile comparison.
Small-sample min/median/max only; no p95, latency pass threshold or user-quality inference.

browser.diagnosis: All 26 acceptance gates passed. Both timing cohorts have five incomplete samples that timed out at inspector_reopen. Fragment completion and content removal can precede completion of the native details close animation, so the capture listener could miss the next opening. The follow-up waits explicitly for details.open == false before the next timed click. Incomplete samples are excluded from successful summaries.
